title: Side wheel stuck
fullDescription:
Shark IQ and Matrix robots report Error 2 when one of the side wheels is bound. Hair, fringe, or stuck debris are most common.

Clear all visible obstructions and confirm the wheel rotates by hand.

fixSteps.title: Flip robot
fixSteps.instruction: Place upside down on flat surface.

fixSteps.title: Clean wheel
fixSteps.instruction: Cut and remove all debris from wheel axle.

whenToCallPro: If wheel still binds after cleaning.
videoSearchQuery: Shark IQ robot side wheel error fix

faq.a: Yes, Shark sells wheel modules around $40.

title: Brushroll jammed
fullDescription:
Shark's self-cleaning brushroll can still get stopped by large debris like socks. Error 3 indicates the brushroll motor is stalled.

Lift the brush guard, remove the brushroll, and clear any obstruction.

faq.q: Self-cleaning means I never clean it?
faq.a: It removes hair but you still need periodic visual checks.

title: Side brush stuck
fullDescription: Side brush motor will not turn — usually hair around the post.

fixSteps.title: Remove side brush
fixSteps.instruction: Pop the brush off the post.

fixSteps.title: Clear hair
fixSteps.instruction: Pull and cut hair from post.

faq.a: Yes, replace both side brushes together for even wear.

title: Bumper jammed
fullDescription: Bumper switches are stuck in compressed position, often from impact debris.

fixSteps.title: Tap bumper
fixSteps.instruction: Firmly tap several times to free it.

faq.a: Clear toys and clutter before runs.

title: Cliff sensor blocked
fullDescription: IR cliff sensors detect drops. Dirty lenses cause false positives — wipe to clear.

fixSteps.title: Wipe sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Clean four cliff sensors under bumper.

title: Robot is stuck
fullDescription:
Shark error 7 means wheels turn but robot is not moving — usually wedged or high-centered.

Move robot to clear floor and restart.

faq.a: Block off in app or use physical barrier.

title: Dust bin full or missing
shortDescription: Bin is missing or sensor reports it full.
fullDescription: Empty bin, ensure it clicks fully into place. On self-empty models, check the base bag is not full.

fixSteps.title: Empty bin
fixSteps.instruction: Slide out bin, empty into trash.

title: Battery low
fullDescription:
After ~2 years of daily use, the lithium-ion pack capacity drops. Error 10 means the robot cannot complete its job.

Replace battery; cleaning contacts can resolve borderline cases.
whenToCallPro: If new battery does not fix.

title: Charging error
shortDescription: Robot is on dock but not charging.
fullDescription: Charging contacts dirty, dock unplugged, or charger failed.
whenToCallPro: If parts test good but error persists.

faq.a: Should be solid green when ready.

title: Sensor / mapping error
fullDescription: On Matrix and AI Ultra, error 12 indicates the camera or LiDAR cannot localize. Clean lens, ensure adequate lighting, and reboot.

fixSteps.title: Add light
fixSteps.instruction: Turn on room lights for vision-based models.

whenToCallPro: If mapping does not resume after cleaning and reboot.

faq.a: Vision-based models need light; LiDAR models can do dark.

title: Side brushes stuck
fullDescription: Shark Robot Error 1 indicates side brushes are jammed. The robot stops cleaning and reports the error in the SharkClean app.

fixSteps.title: Reboot robot
fixSteps.instruction: Slide power switch off, wait 10 seconds, slide on.

fixSteps.title: Specific repair
fixSteps.instruction: Remove side brush, cut away hair, reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensors and bumpers
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe sensors with dry cloth, free bumper.

fixSteps.title: Resume cleaning
fixSteps.instruction: Place on dock then start a new clean.

whenToCallPro: If the error persists after cleaning and reset, contact Shark support; many issues are warranty-eligible within one year.

faq.a: Remove side brush, cut away hair, reinstall.

faq.q: Does Shark cover this under warranty?
faq.a: Hardware faults within the warranty period are typically covered.
